_doc: Interaction points that stay under a top the validator sees, each with the reason. Key: a repo path or path prefix; value: why it stays. validate-interaction-points skips a point whose file starts with the key.
addons/LifeFramework/Prefabs/Placeables/: Player-placed furniture anchors each piece at its own centre (tools/actions/anchors.json, anchor center): a pick-up or use row on a bed, chair or rug, with no desk row or kit prop beside it to compete with. Not swept in #4871's follow-up; raise a point here when a session shows its row missing.
addons/LF_Everon1989/Prefabs/Buildings/B: The context sits on a ladder inside the bank model (Ladder_Metal_900_B), a climb row on the rungs, not a surface a player looks down at.
